Profil de ressource: Bundle (IPS)

URL officielle: https://interop.esante.gouv.fr/ig/fhir/fr-patient-summary/StructureDefinition/fr-bundle-document-ips Version: 0.1.0
Draft à partir de 2026-09-25 Nom computable: FRBundleDocumentIPS

Synthèse médicale française, basée sur le modèle International Patient Summary d'HL7.

Utilisations:

  • Exemples pour ce/t/te Profil: Bundle/Bundle-IPS-FR-DLU and Bundle/Bundle-IPS-FR

Vous pouvez également vérifier les usages dans le FHIR IG Statistics

Vues formelles du contenu du profil

Description des profils, des différentiels, des instantanés et de leurs représentations.

  • Tableau des éléments clés
  • Tableau différentiel (differential)
  • Tableau récapitulatif (snapshot)
  • Statistiques/Références
  • Tous

Bindings terminologiques

Chemin Statut Usage Jeu de valeurs (ValueSet) Version Source
Bundle.type Base required BundleType 📍4.0.1 Std. FHIR

Contraintes

Id Grade Chemin(s) Description Expression
bdl-1 error Bundle total only when a search or history total.empty() or (type = 'searchset') or (type = 'history')
bdl-2 error Bundle entry.search only when a search entry.search.empty() or (type = 'searchset')
bdl-3 error Bundle entry.request mandatory for batch/transaction/history, otherwise prohibited entry.all(request.exists() = (%resource.type = 'batch' or %resource.type = 'transaction' or %resource.type = 'history'))
bdl-4 error Bundle entry.response mandatory for batch-response/transaction-response/history, otherwise prohibited entry.all(response.exists() = (%resource.type = 'batch-response' or %resource.type = 'transaction-response' or %resource.type = 'history'))
bdl-5 error Bundle.entry, Bundle.entry:composition, Bundle.entry:patient, Bundle.entry:practitionerRole, Bundle.entry:practitioner, Bundle.entry:organization, Bundle.entry:device, Bundle.entry:encounter, Bundle.entry:location, Bundle.entry:relatedPerson must be a resource unless there's a request or response resource.exists() or request.exists() or response.exists()
bdl-7 error Bundle FullUrl must be unique in a bundle, or else entries with the same fullUrl must have different meta.versionId (except in history bundles) (type = 'history') or entry.where(fullUrl.exists()).select(fullUrl&resource.meta.versionId).isDistinct()
bdl-8 error Bundle.entry, Bundle.entry:composition, Bundle.entry:patient, Bundle.entry:practitionerRole, Bundle.entry:practitioner, Bundle.entry:organization, Bundle.entry:device, Bundle.entry:encounter, Bundle.entry:location, Bundle.entry:relatedPerson fullUrl cannot be a version specific reference fullUrl.contains('/_history/').not()
bdl-9 error Bundle A document must have an identifier with a system and a value type = 'document' implies (identifier.system.exists() and identifier.value.exists())
bdl-10 error Bundle A document must have a date type = 'document' implies (timestamp.hasValue())
bdl-11 error Bundle A document must have a Composition as the first resource type = 'document' implies entry.first().resource.is(Composition)
bdl-12 error Bundle A message must have a MessageHeader as the first resource type = 'message' implies entry.first().resource.is(MessageHeader)
bdle-document-1 error Bundle Un Bundle DOIT inclure une et une seule ressource Composition. entry.resource.ofType(Composition).count() = 1
ele-1 error Bundle.implicitRules, Bundle.identifier, Bundle.type, Bundle.timestamp, Bundle.entry, Bundle.entry.modifierExtension, Bundle.entry.fullUrl, Bundle.entry:composition, Bundle.entry:composition.modifierExtension, Bundle.entry:composition.fullUrl, Bundle.entry:patient, Bundle.entry:patient.modifierExtension, Bundle.entry:patient.fullUrl, Bundle.entry:practitionerRole, Bundle.entry:practitionerRole.modifierExtension, Bundle.entry:practitionerRole.fullUrl, Bundle.entry:practitioner, Bundle.entry:practitioner.modifierExtension, Bundle.entry:practitioner.fullUrl, Bundle.entry:organization, Bundle.entry:organization.modifierExtension, Bundle.entry:organization.fullUrl, Bundle.entry:device, Bundle.entry:device.modifierExtension, Bundle.entry:device.fullUrl, Bundle.entry:encounter, Bundle.entry:encounter.modifierExtension, Bundle.entry:encounter.fullUrl, Bundle.entry:location, Bundle.entry:location.modifierExtension, Bundle.entry:location.fullUrl, Bundle.entry:relatedPerson, Bundle.entry:relatedPerson.modifierExtension, Bundle.entry:relatedPerson.fullUrl All FHIR elements must have a @value or children hasValue() or (children().count() > id.count())
ext-1 error Bundle.entry.modifierExtension, Bundle.entry:composition.modifierExtension, Bundle.entry:patient.modifierExtension, Bundle.entry:practitionerRole.modifierExtension, Bundle.entry:practitioner.modifierExtension, Bundle.entry:organization.modifierExtension, Bundle.entry:device.modifierExtension, Bundle.entry:encounter.modifierExtension, Bundle.entry:location.modifierExtension, Bundle.entry:relatedPerson.modifierExtension Must have either extensions or value[x], not both extension.exists() != value.exists()

Contraintes

Id Grade Chemin(s) Description Expression
bdl-1 error Bundle total only when a search or history total.empty() or (type = 'searchset') or (type = 'history')
bdl-2 error Bundle entry.search only when a search entry.search.empty() or (type = 'searchset')
bdl-3 error Bundle entry.request mandatory for batch/transaction/history, otherwise prohibited entry.all(request.exists() = (%resource.type = 'batch' or %resource.type = 'transaction' or %resource.type = 'history'))
bdl-4 error Bundle entry.response mandatory for batch-response/transaction-response/history, otherwise prohibited entry.all(response.exists() = (%resource.type = 'batch-response' or %resource.type = 'transaction-response' or %resource.type = 'history'))
bdl-5 error Bundle.entry, Bundle.entry:composition, Bundle.entry:patient, Bundle.entry:practitionerRole, Bundle.entry:practitioner, Bundle.entry:organization, Bundle.entry:device, Bundle.entry:encounter, Bundle.entry:location, Bundle.entry:relatedPerson must be a resource unless there's a request or response resource.exists() or request.exists() or response.exists()
bdl-7 error Bundle FullUrl must be unique in a bundle, or else entries with the same fullUrl must have different meta.versionId (except in history bundles) (type = 'history') or entry.where(fullUrl.exists()).select(fullUrl&resource.meta.versionId).isDistinct()
bdl-8 error Bundle.entry, Bundle.entry:composition, Bundle.entry:patient, Bundle.entry:practitionerRole, Bundle.entry:practitioner, Bundle.entry:organization, Bundle.entry:device, Bundle.entry:encounter, Bundle.entry:location, Bundle.entry:relatedPerson fullUrl cannot be a version specific reference fullUrl.contains('/_history/').not()
bdl-9 error Bundle A document must have an identifier with a system and a value type = 'document' implies (identifier.system.exists() and identifier.value.exists())
bdl-10 error Bundle A document must have a date type = 'document' implies (timestamp.hasValue())
bdl-11 error Bundle A document must have a Composition as the first resource type = 'document' implies entry.first().resource.is(Composition)
bdl-12 error Bundle A message must have a MessageHeader as the first resource type = 'message' implies entry.first().resource.is(MessageHeader)
bdle-document-1 error Bundle Un Bundle DOIT inclure une et une seule ressource Composition. entry.resource.ofType(Composition).count() = 1

Id Grade Chemin(s) Description Expression
bdl-1 error Bundle total only when a search or history total.empty() or (type = 'searchset') or (type = 'history')
bdl-2 error Bundle entry.search only when a search entry.search.empty() or (type = 'searchset')
bdl-3 error Bundle entry.request mandatory for batch/transaction/history, otherwise prohibited entry.all(request.exists() = (%resource.type = 'batch' or %resource.type = 'transaction' or %resource.type = 'history'))
bdl-4 error Bundle entry.response mandatory for batch-response/transaction-response/history, otherwise prohibited entry.all(response.exists() = (%resource.type = 'batch-response' or %resource.type = 'transaction-response' or %resource.type = 'history'))
bdl-5 error Bundle.entry, Bundle.entry:composition, Bundle.entry:patient, Bundle.entry:practitionerRole, Bundle.entry:practitioner, Bundle.entry:organization, Bundle.entry:device, Bundle.entry:encounter, Bundle.entry:location, Bundle.entry:relatedPerson must be a resource unless there's a request or response resource.exists() or request.exists() or response.exists()
bdl-7 error Bundle FullUrl must be unique in a bundle, or else entries with the same fullUrl must have different meta.versionId (except in history bundles) (type = 'history') or entry.where(fullUrl.exists()).select(fullUrl&resource.meta.versionId).isDistinct()
bdl-8 error Bundle.entry, Bundle.entry:composition, Bundle.entry:patient, Bundle.entry:practitionerRole, Bundle.entry:practitioner, Bundle.entry:organization, Bundle.entry:device, Bundle.entry:encounter, Bundle.entry:location, Bundle.entry:relatedPerson fullUrl cannot be a version specific reference fullUrl.contains('/_history/').not()
bdl-9 error Bundle A document must have an identifier with a system and a value type = 'document' implies (identifier.system.exists() and identifier.value.exists())
bdl-10 error Bundle A document must have a date type = 'document' implies (timestamp.hasValue())
bdl-11 error Bundle A document must have a Composition as the first resource type = 'document' implies entry.first().resource.is(Composition)
bdl-12 error Bundle A message must have a MessageHeader as the first resource type = 'message' implies entry.first().resource.is(MessageHeader)
bdle-document-1 error Bundle Un Bundle DOIT inclure une et une seule ressource Composition. entry.resource.ofType(Composition).count() = 1

Contraintes

Id Grade Chemin(s) Description Expression
bdl-1 error Bundle total only when a search or history total.empty() or (type = 'searchset') or (type = 'history')
bdl-2 error Bundle entry.search only when a search entry.search.empty() or (type = 'searchset')
bdl-3 error Bundle entry.request mandatory for batch/transaction/history, otherwise prohibited entry.all(request.exists() = (%resource.type = 'batch' or %resource.type = 'transaction' or %resource.type = 'history'))
bdl-4 error Bundle entry.response mandatory for batch-response/transaction-response/history, otherwise prohibited entry.all(response.exists() = (%resource.type = 'batch-response' or %resource.type = 'transaction-response' or %resource.type = 'history'))
bdl-5 error Bundle.entry, Bundle.entry:composition, Bundle.entry:patient, Bundle.entry:practitionerRole, Bundle.entry:practitioner, Bundle.entry:organization, Bundle.entry:device, Bundle.entry:encounter, Bundle.entry:location, Bundle.entry:relatedPerson must be a resource unless there's a request or response resource.exists() or request.exists() or response.exists()
bdl-7 error Bundle FullUrl must be unique in a bundle, or else entries with the same fullUrl must have different meta.versionId (except in history bundles) (type = 'history') or entry.where(fullUrl.exists()).select(fullUrl&resource.meta.versionId).isDistinct()
bdl-8 error Bundle.entry, Bundle.entry:composition, Bundle.entry:patient, Bundle.entry:practitionerRole, Bundle.entry:practitioner, Bundle.entry:organization, Bundle.entry:device, Bundle.entry:encounter, Bundle.entry:location, Bundle.entry:relatedPerson fullUrl cannot be a version specific reference fullUrl.contains('/_history/').not()
bdl-9 error Bundle A document must have an identifier with a system and a value type = 'document' implies (identifier.system.exists() and identifier.value.exists())
bdl-10 error Bundle A document must have a date type = 'document' implies (timestamp.hasValue())
bdl-11 error Bundle A document must have a Composition as the first resource type = 'document' implies entry.first().resource.is(Composition)
bdl-12 error Bundle A message must have a MessageHeader as the first resource type = 'message' implies entry.first().resource.is(MessageHeader)
bdle-document-1 error Bundle Un Bundle DOIT inclure une et une seule ressource Composition. entry.resource.ofType(Composition).count() = 1
